title: The Old Trick To Finding Minecraft Diamonds
transcript:
Diamonds are one of the most famous rare
resources in Minecraft, and finding them
can be difficult. But, in Minecraft
1.17, a quirk of the game's ore
generation caused there to be a
connection between the locations of
lapis and diamond. If a player
discovered lapis ore, they could always
find diamonds by digging four blocks
north and four blocks down. This version
had an additional trick where finding a
circular clay pattern could lead the
player towards diamonds with a high
success rate. However, both of these
methods were removed in the following
update.
summary: No supported Minecraft mining technique was identified from the available transcript.
